chunks: And Ali, peace be upon him, said:
Concerning the illness that afflicts a child: indeed, it is an expiation for his parents.

key_terms.كَفَّارَةٌ: an expiation that removes sins or spiritual burden

ai.seo_question: How does a child’s illness spiritually affect the parents in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam Ali عليه السلام teaches that a child’s illness can serve as a means of expiation for the parents. The hadith frames such hardship within a spiritual and moral perspective, linking family trials to divine mercy and purification.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4694 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"When a child falls ill, it serves as an expiation for the sins of the parents."
